title: Cobb Vanth Recovers in the Bacta Tank
description: When Cad Bane came to Freetown to threaten them into staying out of the fight, he got into a blaster duel with the marshal, Cobb Vanth. Thanks to Cobb Vanth's over-eager deputy, Bane was able to dispatch the pair of them with relative ease. To the residents of Freetown, it seemed like they had lost their sheriff completely. That motivated them to take up arms to protect Tatooine from the Pyke Syndicate. Boba Fett was generous enough to offer the bacta tank inside of Jabba's former palace in order to save Cobb Vanth's life.
